node.statement: Compressed-square estimate from lem-compcb-rectangular-product and the registered extended epsilon-C*-algebra axioms: at level n, ||Z^dagger Z|| lies between (1-epsilon)||Z||^2 and (1+epsilon)||Z||^2, while lem-compcb-rectangular-product applied to the compatible amplified pair (Z^dagger,Z) gives ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z||<=C_r e||Z||^2. Since epsilon<=e, the reverse triangle inequality yields abs(||Z^dagger dot Z||-||Z||^2)<=(C_r+1)e||Z||^2, uniformly in n.
